items.title: Scaling AI Code Review to 99.9% Uptime Across Regions
items.summary: 我构建了一套多区域 AI 代码审查系统，在 99.9% 月度可用率下将每次审查的 p99 首 token 延迟控制在 3 秒以内、单次成本压到 $0.05 以下。核心策略是通过 Global API 统一接入 184 个模型，按任务复杂度智能路由——简单审查用 DeepSeek V4 Flash（$0.27/M 输入）等低成本模型，复杂场景才调用高价模型，相比全量使用 GPT-4o 节省了 40-65% 的成本，而代码审查质量仅下降 5-8%。架构上采用多区域容灾与优雅降级机制，确保单个区域故障时系统整体不中断。
items.why_now: 2026年模型成本最高差9倍，选型+多区域架构已成刚需。
items.summary_en: An author shares their experience building a multi-region AI code review pipeline achieving 99.9% monthly uptime, p99 first-token latency under 3 seconds, and a cost per review under $0.05 by routing requests across models accessed via a single Global API endpoint (184 models, $0.01–$3.50/M tokens), selecting cost-efficient models like DeepSeek V4 Flash ($0.27/$1.10 per M tokens) over GPT-4o (9x cheaper input/output) while retaining ~84.6% benchmark quality, and implementing regional failover with graceful degradation for bursty webhook-driven PR traffic.

items.title: Mapping SQLite result columns back to their source `table.column`
items.summary: 我让 Claude Code（Opus 4.8）研究如何逆向映射SQLite查询结果中的列到其来源的 `table.column`，尝试了三种方案：使用 apsw 库、通过 ctypes 调用 SQLite 的 `sqlite3_column_table_name()` C 函数（Python 中未直接暴露），以及巧妙解析 EXPLAIN 语句的输出。
items.why_now: 刚发布的 API 可通过映射 SQLite 结果列溯源至 `table.column`，提升数据分析透明度。
items.summary_en: Datasette developer Simon Willison tasked Claude Code Opus 4.8 to solve mapping SQLite query result columns back to their source `table.column` across joins and CTEs. Three viable approaches emerged: using the `apsw` library, calling SQLite's unexposed C function via `ctypes`, and clever interrogation of `EXPLAIN` output. The mapping would enable column-level source annotation for arbitrary SQL results in Datasette.

items.title: Show HN: I am running 3 coding agents non-stop over the last 3 days. Here is how
items.summary: 作者基于 Claude Code、Codex、Agy 和 Opencode 四个编码代理，利用 Beads 作为轻量级任务图谱追踪器，结合 Git worktree 实现多 worker 隔离，构建了可7x24小时连续运行的自动化编码系统。为控制成本，采用最强模型（如 Sonnet 4.6）做任务设计、本地部署的 qwen3.6:36B（36GB显存、256K上下文）执行编码任务、再用强模型验证结果的混合策略，使免费本地模型在任务清晰时表现超预期。系统通过 Telegram 集成实现人机异步交互，并已在 fleet 和数据类项目中验证可行性。
items.why_now: 本地大模型免费跑通24x7编程代理，AP
items.summary_en: The author ran 3 coding agents (Claude, Codex, Opencode, and Agy) non-stop for 3 days using Claude Code's headless mode with task queuing through Beads—a Dolt-powered dependency-aware tracker. To avoid high API costs, the system uses strong models for task design and review, with a local qwen3.6:36B model on 36GB GPUs handling implementation via Ollama, using 24/7 orchestration and a Telegram integration for human-in-the-loop prompts. Running 3 workers concurrently keeps GPU load at 100% by offsetting idle waits when agents need human input, showing that weaker local models can produce solid results on well-defined tasks.

items.title: I Cut RAG Costs 65% With DeepSeek + ChromaDB — Full Data
items.why_now: DeepSeek V4 Pro在基准测试中超越GPT-4o约4.4个百分点，且成本仅为GPT-4o的约五分之一，性价比优势显著。
items.summary_en: The author benchmarked 184 models over six weeks to tackle a $14,800/month RAG workload, testing five key models across five categories (factual recall, citation accuracy, refusals, latency, and coherence) with 500 queries per model repeated three times. DeepSeek V4 Pro scored highest at 91.7 vs. GPT-4o at 87.3, while DeepSeek V4 Flash achieved 87.1 at dramatically lower cost ($0.27/M input + $1.10/M output vs. GPT-4o's $2.50/$10.00). Pairing DeepSeek with ChromaDB yielded a 65% cost reduction, with model selection explaining 94% of total spend variance (R² = 0.94), and full pipeline latency averaged 1.2s at 320 tokens/sec throughput.

items.title: Show HN: Web Researcher MCP – Search with verify citations and sources
items.summary: Web Researcher MCP 是一款开源（MIT）单 Go 二进制工具，为 AI 助手的 MCP 协议提供网页搜索，并通过 Crossref 验证论文真实性、利用 Retraction Watch 数据检测撤稿文献，同时比对引用与原文的核心主张，还自动将无法访问的链接存档至 Wayback Machine；用户可直接提交 BibTeX、RIS 或 CSL-JSON 格式参考文献，工具即可标注无法解析或已撤稿的条目。该方案针对 LLM 输出“看似可信实则虚假、失效或无关的引用”的普遍痛点，实现了参考文献的自动化交叉核验流程。
items.why_now: 刚发布升级版新特性，解决了AI研究时引用难验证的痛点。
items.summary_en: Web Researcher MCP is an open-source single binary tool (MIT-licensed Go) that integrates web search into AI assistants while solving unreliable citations. It verifies sources against Crossref for existence, Retraction Watch for retractions, and matches claims against source content, and accepts BibTeX/ RIS/CSL-JSON bibliography inputs to flag dead entries. Dead links are archived to Wayback Machine and it supports major search engines including domain-specific ones.

items.title: I made a sitemap generator for mdBook. It was my first time releasing a crate!
items.summary: 一名日本高中生开发了名为 **mdbook-sitemap** 的 Rust 编写的 mdBook 站点地图生成工具，以 Cargo 包形式发布，用于解决现有方案不支持最新版 mdBook 或无法通过 Cargo 安装的问题；该工具通过读取 mdBook 输出的 JSON 结构自动生成 sitemap.xml，用户仅需执行 `cargo install mdbook-sitemap` 并在 book.toml 中配置 base-url 即可使用，其开发过程借助 Claude Sonnet 并由集成测试保障了与最新版 mdBook 的兼容性。
items.why_now: mdBook 刚更新版本不兼容旧的 sitemap 工具，Rust 原生替代品刚发布。
items.summary_en: A Japanese high school developer created **mdbook-sitemap**, a Rust-based mdBook backend that automatically generates `sitemap.xml` files when running `mdbook build`. Unlike the Go-based alternatives, it is installable via `cargo install mdbook-sitemap`, requires only adding `[output.sitemap]` and `base-url` to `book.toml`, and works with the latest mdBook versions. Initially generated with Claude Sonnet, the code was refined with manual fixes for JSON parsing mismatches and validated through integration tests via a custom `Tester` trait.

items.title: Ditch Electron: Building a Local-First Sync Engine with Turso & SQLModel
items.summary: 本文介绍了如何利用 Turso（libSQL）和 SQLModel 构建一个本地优先的同步引擎，实现应用在多设备间的无缝数据同步与离线使用。通过采用 UUIDv7 作为主键（避免离线并发写入冲突并保持 SQLite B-Tree 索引高效）以及“墓碑删除”模式（用 `is_deleted` 标记替代物理删除，防止数据“复活”），解决了分布式环境下的数据一致性问题。具体实现基于 Python 层的 SQLModel 定义数据模型，并结合 Turso 的嵌入式副本同步机制，实现 0.1ms 级本地读写延迟与云端双向同步。
items.why_now: 文章未提及时效性信号，无法说明"现在"值得关注的原因。
items.summary_en: This article details building a Local-First Sync Engine using Turso (libSQL) and SQLModel in Python, targeting 0.1ms latency, offline-first operation, and multi-device cloud-edge SQLite replication. It introduces UUIDv7 (RFC 9562) as the primary key strategy to prevent offline write collisions while maintaining SQLite B-Tree insert performance, and a Tombstone deletion pattern (is_deleted flag) to prevent ghost records during sync. The implementation uses SQLModel to combine SQLAlchemy ORM with Pydantic validation, with database connections configured via environment variables for edge deployment.

items.title: phuryn/pm-skills
items.summary: PM Skills Marketplace 是一款面向产品经理的 AI 工具集，提供68个 PM 技能、42个链式工作流，覆盖发现、战略、执行、发布等9大环节，适配 Claude Code、Cowork 及 OpenAI Codex 等平台；其核心作用是将 Teresa Torres、Marty Cagan 等权威 PM 框架嵌入 AI 对话流程，通过结构化的技能链（如 brainstorm-ideas → identify-assumptions）提升产品决策质量，而非仅加速文档生成；用户可通过 GitHub 一键安装全部 9 个插件，或使用 `/discover`、`/strategy` 等命令快速调用具体工作流。
items.why_now: 刚发布支持Claude Code、Cowork及Codex CLI的PM技能市场，含68项技能和42个工作流。
items.summary_en: The **PM Skills Marketplace** (`phuryn/pm-skills`) offers **68 agentic skills and 42 chained workflows** across **9 plugins**, covering the full product lifecycle from discovery to shipping AI-built code. It provides structured, step-by-step PM frameworks (inspired by Teresa Torres, Marty Cagan, Alberto Savoia) — including commands like `/discover`, `/write-prd`, and `/plan-launch` — that chain multiple skills into end-to-end workflows. Installation takes one marketplace command plus individual plugin installs for **Claude Code**, **Claude Cowork** (recommended for non-developers), and **Codex CLI**, with all plugins loadable automatically or on-demand.

items.title: “宁王系”，排队 IPO
items.summary: 宁德时代以约41亿元认购中恒电气控股股东中恒科技投资新增注册资本，将持股49%，双方围绕绿色ICT基础设施、算电协同及储能等领域展开战略合作，将宁德时代储能系统通过中恒电气数据中心HVDC渠道切入AI算力基础设施市场。今年以来，宁德时代还入股富临精工、世纪互联（约64亿元收购6.5亿股）、赛力斯旗下赛豆科技，并通过旗下投资平台溥泉资本管理百亿元规模的产业基金，已投资近30个项目、累计出资约60亿元，在锂电、新能源、具身智能（如银河通用机器人）等领域构建横跨产业链上下游的投资帝国。以宁德时代、华为哈勃投资、联想创投为代表的产业CVC正成为中国创新资本市场中日益重要的新兴力量。
items.why_now: 宁德时代41亿入股中恒电气，跨界布局AI数据中心储能赛道
items.summary_en: CATL (Ning Wang) is aggressively expanding its CVC portfolio with a ¥4.1 billion strategic investment in Zhongheng Electric's holding company, acquiring a 15.3% stake to integrate its battery storage systems with Zhongheng’s HVDC power solutions for AI data centers. Beyond this deal, CATL has invested in over 158 companies directly and through LP commitments in funds like Boyu Capital, targeting sectors far beyond its core battery business—including semiconductors, robotics, and aerospace—via its dedicated investment platform Pucquan Capital. This reflects a broader trend of Chinese industrial giants like Huawei (via Hubble Investment) and Lenovo Ventures emerging as dominant CVC forces, leveraging corporate capital to build strategic ecosystems and pursue financial returns across hard-tech supply chains.

items.title: Show HN: GEDD – A Systematic Evidence Driven LLM as a Judge Framework
items.summary: AWS 发布了 GEDD（Generative Evidence Driven Judge with Dual-Signal），一套系统化的“LLM-as-a-Judge”评估框架，旨在通过引入包含结构化和非结构化双信号的方法，解决 LLM 作为评估者时容易产生幻觉和指令遵循不完整的问题。该框架发布于 GitHub 开源仓库，但其最初的介绍文章目前仅获得了少量关注。
items.summary_en: GEDD is a systematic, evidence-driven framework for using LLMs as judges, designed to improve evaluation reliability by grounding assessments in explicit evidence. It introduces structured prompting and scoring rubrics to reduce subjectivity in LLM-based evaluations. The open-source implementation is available on GitHub under AWS Samples, targeting developers building robust LLM evaluation pipelines.

items.title: Show HN: Trace, offline Mac meeting transcripts you can flag mid-call
items.summary: Trace 是一款 Mac 菜单栏应用，通过全局快捷键一键在后台录制系统音频和麦克风，无需调用任何会议机器人，支持 Core Audio 级进程级音频捕获，兼容所有会议应用及面对面交谈。转录完全在设备端运行，提供 Parakeet-TDT（快速）和 Whisper large-v3-turbo via WhisperKit（高精度）两个引擎，通过 Core ML 在 Apple Silicon 神经引擎上运行，音频数据不离开本机。特色功能包括通话中标记"关键时刻"（支持时间戳内联显示）和实时发言回顾，会话数据以本地文件保存（wav + JSON + Markdown），支持连接 Google Calendar 自动命名会话。应用售价 £9.99，已在 App Store 上架。
items.summary_en: Trace is a menu-bar Mac app that records and transcribes meetings fully offline—no bot joins the call, no audio leaves the device, no accounts or telemetry. It captures mic and system audio via Core Audio, transcribes on-device using Core ML on Apple Silicon (fast: Parakeet-TDT; accurate: Whisper large-v3-turbo), and supports global shortcuts to flag mid-call "key moments" with timestamps and to view a live recap. Sessions are stored as plain files (.wav, .json, .md) on disk, with optional Google Calendar integration for auto-naming.

items.title: Show HN: Galdor – a Go LLM agent framework with built-in tracing and replay
items.summary: Galdor 是一个用 Go 语言编写的 LLM Agent 框架，内置了 tracing（追踪）和 replay（回放）功能，方便开发者调试和复现 Agent 的执行过程。该项目在 Hacker News 上发布后获得了 5 个 points，目前尚无评论。
items.summary_en: Galdor is a Go-based LLM agent framework featuring built-in tracing and replay capabilities, enabling developers to record and replay agent execution for debugging and testing. It supports OpenAI and Anthropic models out of the box and provides a declarative configuration interface for defining agents, tools, and workflows. The project is open source and currently has an initial release on GitHub.

items.title: Making sales but unsure if business is sustainable.
items.summary: 该团队开发了一款面向银行客户的实体产品（B2B2C模式），已与11家资产规模从5000万美元到80亿美元的银行达成试点合作，以每单位约7.5美元的成本售出8000件产品，单笔试点合同金额在4000至10000美元之间，毛利率约70%。尽管银行采购决策周期长且产品尚未实物交付，客户已表达扩展至六位数年合同的意向，并正推动签订年度订阅协议。团队担忧能否将试点转化为经常性收入（ARR），目标是在覆盖约4000家金融机构的市场中实现年均2000万美元营收，目前已完成100万美元融资，面临规模化与留存的双重压力。
items.summary_en: Sold 8,000 units of a B2B2C physical product to 11 banks (ranging from $50M to $8B in assets) via pre-sale pilots priced at $4,000–$10,000 each, with a unit cost of ~$7.50 and ~70% gross margin. The company projects scaling to $20M/year by Year 5 if it converts pilots into mid-five-figure annual contracts across ~4,000 target financial institutions. Key risk remains turning initial traction into consistent ARR after raising $1M in funding.

items.title: Meta reportedly moves to unwind $2B Manus deal after Beijing’s demand
items.summary: Meta reportedly moves to unwind its $2 billion acquisition of Chinese AI startup Manus following pressure from Beijing, which demanded the deal be reversed over national security and data sovereignty concerns. The move underscores escalating geopolitical tensions impacting cross-border tech deals, particularly those involving sensitive AI technologies and large-scale user data. If finalized, this would mark one of the largest forced unwindings of a tech acquisition driven by regulatory intervention.
items.summary_en: Meta is reportedly unwinding its $2 billion acquisition of Chinese AI startup Manus following demands from Beijing regulators, signaling increased scrutiny over large-scale tech deals. The move underscores growing geopolitical tensions affecting cross-border transactions in the technology sector, particularly those involving Chinese artificial intelligence companies.

items.title: I’m building GOT — a smarter companion for Git (and no, it’s not a replacement)
items.summary: GOT是一个开源的Git兼容工具，旨在通过逻辑工作区（如workspace create/add-file）、知识图谱（链接提交与设计决策）和事件总线架构增强Git，提供语义化理解和知识管理功能，当前核心功能如Git适配器和提交向导已实现，后续将推出语义合并与AI冲突解决。开发者可通过本地优先的方式使用，项目基于Go和SQLite构建，代码已发布于GitHub（https://github.com/supunhg/got），欢迎参与贡献和反馈痛点。开发者可创建独立视图组织文件与分支（如got workspace系列命令），并计划未来支持GitHub/GitLab集成。
items.summary_en: GOT is an open-source companion tool for Git that adds semantic understanding, knowledge mapping, and improved developer UX without replacing Git itself. Key features include workspace management for grouping related branches/files/decisions, a knowledge engine for linking commits to architecture decisions, and an event bus architecture for modularity and future plugins (powered by a Go/SQLite-based CLI). The roadmap includes semantic merge and AI-assisted conflict resolution, alongside GitHub/GitLab integrations. Eager contributors can find the source code at https://github.com/supunhg/got.

items.title: Building Resilient Multi-Agent Systems
items.summary: 文章介绍了构建高容错多智能体系统的核心工程实践与架构演进。指出在传统单智能体基础上，生产级分布式系统正演进为由多种专用智能体协作的多智能体架构
items.summary_en: Multi-agent systems coordinate specialized AI agents to decompose complex tasks, combining LLMs with instructions, memory, tools, RAG, MCP, and A2A protocols to overcome individual LLM limitations like hallucinations and limited memory. Production-ready architectures must prioritize resilience—designing for graceful degradation when agents, models, or infrastructure fail—ensuring continued operation in distributed environments where delays and downtime are common. Building reliable multi-agent systems requires not only intelligent agents but robust engineering practices for real-world distributed computing challenges.

items.title: Using the System Prompt / Preferences Field
items.summary: 在 Claude.ai 等 LLM 前端界面的系统提示（System Prompt）或偏好设置字段中预先写入用户背景与响应偏好，可显著提升每次对话的准确度与效率，避免重复输入身份信息；例如在 Claude.ai 的 General → Profile 中配置包含批判性应答、技术反馈分段交付、优先使用最新网络搜索等指令。该方法虽会额外消耗 token，但省去每次手动说明信息的步骤，对经常使用 AI 的专业合规人士而言性价比极高。
items.summary_en: Setting a persistent system prompt or preferences field in an LLM interface—such as Claude.ai’s Profile settings—significantly improves response quality by providing consistent user context (e.g., profession, communication preferences) across all conversations, eliminating redundant explanations and sycophantic or overly cautious replies. This customization tailors outputs to the user’s expertise level and needs, though it consumes additional tokens. The article includes a sample prompt that instructs the model to prioritize accuracy, avoid flattery and emojis, use web search for up-to-date information, and deliver concise, step-by-step technical guidance.

items.title: maziyarpanahi/openmed
items.summary: maziyarpanahi/openmed 是一款开源、本地优先的医疗 AI 工具，提供超过 1000 个生物医学与临床模型，支持 12 种语言和 247 个 PII 检查点，可在设备端完成临床文本的实体提取与去标识化，无需上传数据至云端。它通过 Python 一行代码即可调用（如 `analyze_text` 函数），并原生支持 Apple MLX 加速，在 Apple Silicon 上推理速度比 CPU PyTorch 快 24–33 倍，同时提供 Swift 框架 OpenMedKit 用于 iOS/macOS 应用集成。该项目采用 Apache-2.0 协议，完全免费、无供应商锁定，适用于 HIPAA 合规场景下的离线医疗数据处理。

items.title: 高瓴出手了一家消费级柔性机器人公司，要把“大白”从电影搬进现实家庭｜硬氪首发
items.summary: 消费级柔性机器人公司 SoulX 完成数千万元天使轮融资，投资方为高瓴创投，首款睡眠安抚机器人 MoYa 将于2026年下半年正式发布。MoYa 采用自研柔性气动材料与控制算法，以气泵驱动替代传统电机，通过胸前和后背的触觉传感器实现压力闭环反馈，支持跟随用户呼吸节律的动态拍抚，完成从高唤醒到放松状态的神经切换。产品遵循被动触发原则，仅在用户触碰或语音指令时响应，首代系统已完成关键链路验证并进入小范围批量测试，约七成用户反馈使用后更易放松，超六成认为入睡体验有所改善。
items.summary_en: SoulX, a consumer-grade flexible robotics company, has completed a tens-of-millions RMB angel round led by Hillhouse Capital, with funds directed toward product iteration, R&D, and supply chain scaling. Its first product, MoYa—a sleep-soothing robot launching in the second half of 2026—uses proprietary soft pneumatic materials and control algorithms to deliver huggable, noise-free tactile comfort that activates the vagus nerve and synchronizes with the user's breathing rhythm via real-time sensor feedback. Unlike conventional companion robots, MoYa adopts a passive-trigger design (responding only to touch or voice) to minimize psychological barriers, and builds a "family dynamic mind profile" that retains contextual life narratives—not just data points—to enable emotionally coherent, long-term companionship.

items.title: refactoringhq/tolaria
items.summary: Tolaria 是一款开源桌面应用，支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux，用于管理 Markdown 知识库，核心原则包括文件优先（纯 Markdown 文件、数据完全归用户所有）、Git 优先（每个 vault 即一个 git 仓库）、离线优先（无需账户和云服务）以及开源。该应用完全使用 Tauri、React 和 TypeScript 构建，支持 Claude Code、Codex CLI 和 Gemini CLI 等 AI 代理集成，主打键盘操作体验。它由开发者 Luca 为管理个人超过 10,000 条笔记的真实需求驱动开发，支持 Homebrew 安装或直接从 releases 页面下载。
items.summary_en: Tolaria is a free, open-source, offline-first desktop app built with Tauri, React, and TypeScript for managing plain Markdown knowledge bases with Git-based versioning — no accounts, subscriptions, or cloud dependencies. It supports macOS, Windows (Authenticode-signed), and Linux, and is designed for power users with keyboard-first navigation, YAML frontmatter-based "types" as flexible navigation lenses, and AI-agent integration via Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, or any custom setup using a bundled AGENTS file. Created by Luca at Refactoring to manage a 10,000+ note personal vault, it treats notes as portable Markdown files in a standard Git repository with zero lock-in.

items.title: 读懂SpaceX的两万亿故事：为什么马斯克每一手棋，永远都可以提前摆好？
items.summary: SpaceX于2025年6月12日以135美元发行价登陆纳斯达克，募资约750亿美元，市值一度突破2万亿美元。其2025年总营收187亿美元，其中星链连接业务贡献约44亿美元经营利润，是唯一盈利板块，而并表的xAI一年亏损约64亿美元，吞掉了全部利润。SpaceX的核心逻辑是：用可回收的Falcon 9（2025年发射165次、助推器回收仅失手3次）压低运力成本，再用星链作为"内部甲方"消化运力，同时为下一代100-150吨运力的星舰和"太空算力"新故事提前布局更大的商业市场。
items.summary_en: SpaceX went public on June 12, pricing at $135 per share and raising approximately $750 billion, briefly reaching a $2 trillion market cap on its first trading day. Despite a net loss of $4.9 billion in 2025 on $18.7 billion revenue, its Starlink division generates roughly $4.4 billion in operating profit, effectively subsidizing the company’s massive investments in AI subsidiary xAI (~$6.4B operating loss) and the development of the Starship rocket. SpaceX’s long-term strategy—launching Starlink before proving rocket reusability, and now pivoting Starship’s narrative toward "space computing"—demonstrates a pattern of preemptively creating internal demand to justify and fund increasingly ambitious, capital-intensive technologies.

items.title: 扎克伯格承认 Meta AI 转型"脱轨"：裁员 10%、转岗 7000 人后组织调整过快
items.summary: 扎克伯格在内部备忘录中承认 Meta AI 转型节奏过快，导致员工安置和跨部门协作困难，称未来将"几乎肯定会犯更多错误"。Meta 已在今年 5 月裁员 10%，并将 7000 人转岗至 AI 相关项目，新成立的应用 AI 工程部门个人贡献者与管理者比例高达 50：1。为缓解组织摩擦，公司正增加团队建设预算并于 7 月举办黑客松，扎克伯格重申今年不会再进行全公司裁员。
items.summary_en: Meta CEO Zuckerberg admitted in a leaked internal memo that the company's AI transition was progressing too quickly, citing employee placement and management issues, betting that "almost certainly more mistakes" will be made. In May, Meta cut 10% of its global workforce while redeploying 7,000 employees to new AI projects. The company increased team budgets and plans a July hackathon to improve collaboration, with a newly formed Applied AI engineering department reaching an individual contributor-to-manager ratio as high as 50:1. Zuckerberg confirmed the company will not conduct another company-wide layoff this year.

items.title: 智谱 GLM-5.2 全量开放，支持 1M 上下文且下周开源
items.summary: GLM-5.2 是智谱迄今最强的开源模型，支持真正可用的 1M 上下文，在长程任务中保持领先，被称为最强国产 Coding 模型。该模型已于今晚 5:21 面向 GLM Coding Plan 全量用户开放（覆盖 Lite、Pro、Max、团队版），API 将于下周上线，模型下周正式开源，遵循 MIT 协议。
items.summary_en: GLM-5.2 is Zhipu's most powerful open-source model to date, featuring a fully functional 1M context length with leading performance on long-context tasks and its claim as the strongest domestic coding model. It was fully rolled out tonight at 5:21 PM to all GLM Coding Plan users (including Lite, Pro, Max, and Team tiers), with the API launching next week alongside the model's official open-source release under the MIT license.

items.title: SemiAnalysis 洞察 Token 经济：200 美元 AI 订阅榨出 70 倍用量
items.summary: SemiAnalysis 实测发现，月费 200 美元的 Claude Max 20x 订阅方案 API 价值高达约 8000 美元，ChatGPT Pro 20x 方案更是可达约 14000 美元，用户通过订阅最多能获取 40-70 倍的 API 价值，价格体系在高频满负荷使用下恐难以为继。
items.summary_en: SemiAnalysis tested all subscription tiers from Anthropic and OpenAI by running intensive coding tasks until hitting weekly limits. The $200/month Claude Max 20x plan yields up to ~$8,000 in API-equivalent tokens, while ChatGPT Pro 20x reaches ~$14,000, giving users 40–70x the API value. The firm warns this pricing model may be unsustainable if heavy users consistently max out their limits.

items.title: 谷歌Android安全负责人因反对军事AI合作辞职
items.summary: René Mayrhofer于5月18日辞去谷歌Android安全负责人职务，谴责公司放弃碳中和目标并与美国战争部签署允许AI用于"任何合法目的"的协议。谷歌2025年2月更新AI原则时移除了不开发武器或监控工具的承诺，4月下旬宣布向五角大楼提供AI用于机密工作。Mayrhofer担忧谷歌AI可能被用于针对公民的大规模监控，包括威胁其自身及家人安全。
items.summary_en: 谷歌Android安全负责人René Mayrhofer于5月18日辞职，公开谴责公司放弃碳中和目标并与美国战争部签署允许AI用于"任何合法目的"的协议，担忧谷歌AI可能被用于大规模监控公民包括其家人，此次辞职正值2025年2月谷歌修改AI原则并4月下旬宣布向五角大楼提供机密AI服务之后。

items.title: Show HN: I built 80 mini-games using Fable before it was shut down
items.summary_en: A developer built 80 AI-managed mini-games using Fable before its shutdown, spending approximately $2,300 in API tokens. They launched an open beta with a temporarily enabled free tier and manually adjusted outputs for visual consistency. The project garnered moderate traction on Hacker News with 43 points and 45 comments.

items.title: Show HN: I run a vision model on every screenshot, locally, on a 4GB GPU
items.summary_en: ScreenMind is a local vision model that uses vLLM quantization to run on just 4GB GPUs, processing every system screenshot in real time for automated task inference. It helps prevent forgetting open tasks, running fully locally without cloud costs. The open-source tool is available on GitHub for anyone to deploy.

items.title: Show HN: A bunch of Apache2/MIT log generators
items.summary: expanso-io/log-simulators 是一个在 GitHub 上开源的日志生成工具集，专为 Apache2 和 MIT 协议场景设计。该工具可模拟多种开源项目的真实日志数据，用于开发与测试环境的快速搭建。项目已发布在 GitHub，并在 Hacker News 上获得初步关注。
items.summary_en: A collection of open-source log simulators under Apache2/MIT licenses, designed to generate realistic log data for testing and development purposes. The project is hosted on GitHub under the expanso-io organization. It received 3 points on Hacker News with no comments at the time of posting.

items.title: Show HN: Open-Sourced Approxima, Our Agentic QA Tool to Catch Breakages Faster
items.summary: Approxima 是一款开源（MIT 协议）且可完全自托管的 Web 智能体 QA 工具，由 YC W26 团队开发，旨在更快捕获产品故障。其核心功能包括：Explore Mode（用户仅需一两句话描述用户旅程，智能体自动推导并执行步骤）、A/B 测试（支持在平台内调整系统提示词并进行对比测试）以及 Self-healing（旅程步骤随产品迭代自动更新，逐步减少决策次数和 token 消耗）。
items.summary_en: Approxima, a YC W26 startup, has open-sourced its agentic QA tool under the MIT license, enabling self-hosted deployment. The platform features an Explore Mode where agents autonomously determine user journey steps from brief descriptions, A/B testing for system prompt optimization, and self-healing capabilities that reduce token usage over time as agents adapt to product changes.

items.title: Show HN: Local RAG memory system that AI can write directly to
items.summary: local-memory-mcp 是一个本地 MCP 服务器，支持大语言模型直接读写 RAG 向量库，内置块大小限制和信息更新淘汰机制以提升效率。该工具解决了每次新建对话时需重复共享信息的痛点，节省大量时间和 token 消耗。项目已在 Hacker News 发布，获得 3 分评价。
items.summary_en: The author released **local-memory-mcp**, a local MCP server (Model Context Protocol) that enables LLMs to read from and write to a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) memory system, solving the problem of repeatedly resurfacing information across new chat sessions. Built-in features include **maximum chunk size controls** and an **automatic deprecation mechanism** that updates outdated data, improving both efficiency and token usage. The developer highlights significant **time and token savings** as the primary benefit based on personal/family use.

items.title: Meta Ads
items.summary: 用户将 Claude Coworker 通过 MCP 接入 Meta Ads 管理，针对 Facebook Follower 和网站访客进行再投放，淡季 2 周内广告效率显著提升，并计划后续扩展至 Google Ads。

items.title: repo-slopscore: Detecting AI/LLM contributions in git repositories via commit history analysis
items.summary: repo-slopscore 是一个通过分析 git 提交历史来检测 AI/LLM 贡献的项目，旨在识别仓库中由自动化或 AI 辅助完成的提交。它利用提交频率、代码变更模式等信号推断 AI 的参与程度，帮助开发者或项目管理者量化 AI 的影响力与渗透率。该工具可作为代码质量与项目管理流程优化的辅助依据。
items.summary_en: **repo-slopscore** is a tool that detects AI/LLM-generated contributions in git repositories by analyzing commit history patterns. It scores commits based on signals such as commit message phrasing, code change characteristics, and temporal patterns typical of LLM-assisted development. The tool enables repository maintainers to quantify and flag potentially AI-generated code contributions at scale.

items.title: [AINews] Fable and Mythos officially too dangerous to release
items.summary: Anthropic在发布仅3天后，以"存在越狱可能构成国家网络安全风险"为由，向全球所有用户紧急叫停了Claude Fable 5和Mythos 5的使用——远超此前仅针对美国政府员工的范围。该措施被业界定义为前所未有的"模型主权"事件，Anthropic则反驳称政府对"非普遍性越狱"仅提供了口头证据，类似能力在GPT-5.5等模型中也已广泛存在。在评估层面，Coding Agent Index已用DeepSWE替换SWE-Bench Pro（因后者存在仓库历史泄露问题），导致排名大幅变化。
items.summary_en:
Anthropic revoked global access to Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5 just three days after release, citing potential national cybersecurity risks and a US government directive—though Anthropic disputes the scope, calling it likely a "misunderstanding" over a narrow jailbreak claim.

The suspension reverberated across downstream tools (Cognition/Devin, Agent Arena) and reshuffled AI benchmarks, after Artificial Analysis replaced gameable SWE-Bench Pro with harder DeepSWE, where Fable 5 [max] led with 77 but was pulled before wider adoption.

Beyond the product disruption, the episode crystallized a growing concern in the AI engineering community about "model sovereignty"—frontier APIs disappearing overnight due to export controls—reinforcing calls for infrastructure diversification and owning the AI stack.

items.title: KPMG pulls report on AI usage due to apparent hallucinations
items.summary: KPMG（毕马威）撤回了一份关于 AI 使用情况的报告，原因是报告中存在明显的 AI "幻觉"问题——即编造了不存在的事实和数据。该事件反映出 AI 生成内容在企业级场景中仍存在严重的事实准确性风险，即使是全球顶级审计机构也未能在 AI 辅助发布前有效识别出虚假信息。
items.summary_en: KPMG withdrew a report on AI usage after discovering apparent hallucinations, indicating factual inaccuracies in AI-generated content. The incident highlights ongoing reliability concerns with AI tools in professional services. No further details on the report's scope or specific errors were disclosed.

items.title: Amazon CEO reportedly raised Anthropic model concerns before government crackdown
items.summary: Amazon CEO Andy Jassy reportedly raised security concerns about models, leading Anthropic to cut off access to two models. This action came ahead of a government crackdown, implicating high-level corporate influence on AI model deployment policy.
items.summary_en: Amazon CEO Andy Jassy reportedly voiced national security concerns about Anthropic's AI models, which led Anthropic to cut off worldwide access to two unspecified models last Friday. This action appears tied to growing U.S. government scrutiny over AI partnerships, particularly involving Anthropic and Amazon, a major cloud and strategic partner of the company.

items.title: OpenAI faces investigation from state attorneys general
items.summary: 美国多个不明身份的总检察长办公室正在对OpenAI展开调查，调查范围涵盖其广告政策以及该公司处理健康数据的方式等多个方面。
items.summary_en: Multiple state attorneys general are launching a broad investigation into OpenAI, examining areas including its advertising policies and management of health data protection.

items.title: 智谱：GLM-5.2将面向GLM Coding Plan全量用户开放
items.summary: 智谱将于今晚5:21向 GLM Coding 计划（含 Lite/Pro/Max/团队版）全量用户开放 GLM-5.2 模型；其 API 下周上线，模型也将按 MIT 协议开源。
items.summary_en: 智谱宣布GLM-5.2将于今晚5:21面向GLM Coding Plan全量用户开放，覆盖Lite/Pro/Max/团队版；其API将于下周上线，模型下周正式开源，遵循MIT协议。

items.title: Anthropic 秘密申请上市，估值 9650 亿美元
items.summary: Anthropic 正式启动秘密上市程序，目前估值已达 9650 亿美元。此次上市标志着其在生成式AI领域的重要资本化进程。
items.summary_en: Anthropic has confidentially filed for an IPO with a reported valuation of approximately $965 billion, marking one of the largest anticipated tech listings of the year. The move positions the AI safety-focused company to enter public markets amid surging demand for advanced large language model providers. Financial terms and timing remain undisclosed as the company continues negotiations with underwriters.

items.title: LMCache/LMCache
items.summary: LMCache 是一个面向大语言模型推理的 KV 缓存管理中间层，可将 KV 缓存从临时状态转化为可持久化复用的 AI 原生知识，通过将 KV 缓存卸载至 CPU 内存、本地 SSD 及 Redis/Mooncake/S3 等远程存储的分层架构，显著降低首 token 延迟（TTFT）并提升吞吐量，尤其适用于长上下文 Agent、多轮对话和 RAG 场景。该方案以独立守护进程方式部署，与推理引擎解耦，支持跨引擎、跨硬件（NVIDIA/AMD/Arm/Ascend）复用 KV 缓存，并已在 vLLM、NVIDIA Dynamo 等主流推理框架中集成，GitHub 星标已超 5,000。此外，LMCache 还支持非前缀 KV 复用（CacheBlend）、PD 分离下的 KV 传输（NVLink/RDMA/TCP）以及可插拔的 KV 压缩与序列化接口，于 2025 年 10 月正式加入 PyTorch 基金会。
items.summary_en: LMCache is a vendor-neutral KV cache management layer for LLM inference that reduces latency and improves throughput for long-context, multi-turn, and RAG workloads. Key features include engine-independent daemon deployment (no fate-sharing with inference engines), persistent tiered offloading of KV cache across GPU memory, CPU RAM, local SSD, Redis, and S3-compatible storage for cross-session reuse, and PD disaggregation with KV transfer over NVLink/RDMA/TCP. The project supports non-prefix KV block reuse via CacheBlend, pluggable storage backends, and production-level observability metrics. LMCache hit 5,000+ GitHub stars, is a PyTorch Foundation project, and has been integrated with NVIDIA Dynamo and vLLM.

directions.name: ReviewRouter

directions.target_user: 拥有 5-50 人规模开发团队、希望降低 AI 代码审查成本但仍需高质量审查的中小企业CTO/SRE
core_features: 输入 Diff 后自动评估复杂度——简单改动走 DeepSeek Flash 等低成本模型，复杂 PR 才调高价模型
单次 p99 首 Token 延迟 < 3 秒，单次审查成本可压至 ~0.05 美元量级
提供简洁 Dashboard 展示审查成本省了多少、每 PR 的问题检出质量评分
directions.why_now: 社区讨论显示开发者正降低 AI 代码审查成本但仍需高质量（多模型路由、按复杂度智能路由成主流），独立开发者及中小企业因缺乏多模型路由能力而承担更高成本，我们以托管 SDK 形式让中小团队也能享受类似路由省钱的方案
directions.monetization: 按 PR 定价（如免费 50 个/月，之后 $0.1/个），或直接接入 API 按调用量计费（提供比直连 GPT-4 省 3-5 倍的折扣价）
directions.source_article: I made a sitemap generator for mdBook. It was my first time releasing a crate!
directions.description_en: Intelligent AI code review router designed to reduce review costs for small-to-medium teams and independent developers
directions.target_user_en: CTOs/SREs at SMEs with 5-50 person dev teams who want to lower AI code review costs while maintaining high-quality reviews

Single p99 first-token latency < 3 seconds, per-review cost compressible to ~$0.05 level

Built-in GitHub Actions CI template that automatically pushes mdBook build artifacts to Pages/Vercel and syncs sitemap to search engines on every push
